bounds.domain: Two full 64-bit thread IDs with the same 32-bit hash, one notification action, one queued worker and separate SMS/MMS acknowledgements. Current role admission occurs when the worker begins. No fairness or provider success is assumed.
bounds.conformance: Five exact Android JVM cases exercise actual notification/PendingIntent identities, MessagingStyle retained text, compose-only reply, the actual receiver and its completion future, and actual SQL provider update predicates for shown/later/foreign/sent rows, role loss and partial provider failure.
bounds.limits: Read predicates are abstracted to selected-thread membership; timestamp units/cutoffs are checked by actual SQLite tests. Separate provider writes can partially succeed. Real default-SMS role grants, system Telephony provider enforcement, carrier delivery, audio/video, system notification rendering and process death remain external. Reply never invokes the send journal or radio.

assumptions: Weak fairness of the admitted worker and return of each provider update with success or failure. This assumes finite provider calls, not successful writes or carrier delivery.
No fairness. An admitted worker, external query or posted Main continuation can remain stalled indefinitely.
